unit: ROOTS responsibility groups; scoped leaves only

namedRoots.scope: Named RC, VM, bank, stack/continuation, symkey anchor and globals RootOrigin adapters with task leases
namedRoots.remaining: No total writer/caller census, independent-worker or whole-root closure follows

globalsPrefix.scope: Common globals extent and admitted registration transaction
globalsPrefix.remaining: Arbitrary value writers and raw cross-VM stores remain separate

symkeyPublish.scope: Native canonical interning, rehash publication and GC anchor handoff as one service responsibility
symkeyPublish.evidence: symkey-publication-result.org; publication92d70198, five gates/21 controls and exact-source original/native consumers
symkeyPublish.remaining: Scope excludes raw Scheme views/mutation, optional debug-GC diagnostics, arbitrary reentry or moving publishers and complete lifetime census

rootViews.scope: Scheme table reflection, iteration and mutable aliases
rootViews.remaining: Stable read views and complete alias/writer admission without changing Scheme identity semantics

rootWriters.scope: Remaining primitive, raw, FFI and cross-VM value writers
rootWriters.evidence: Source-refinement caller inventory; repair evidence is a counterexample input only
rootWriters.remaining: Every affected source freeze must exclude or account for every actual writer and native borrow

rootCensus.scope: Composed caller/lifetime census and frozen root union before worker handoff
rootCensus.evidence: Existing root_dispatch temporal contract and conditional Lean cell laws
rootCensus.remaining: Actual-source coverage, resource lifetime and task-union refinement; local leaf names cannot discharge this group
